chunks: But no. He has not fulfilled what was enjoined on him.

key_terms.أَمَرَهُ: He enjoined upon him / He commanded

ai.seo_question: What does 'He has not fulfilled what was enjoined on him' mean in Surah Abasa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a divine correction of the Prophet's specific action of frowning, highlighting the principle of *Tahqiq* (verification) where even the Prophet's immediate reactions are subject to divine refinement. It underscores the unique status of the Prophet as a recipient of *Wahy* (revelation) who, while infallible in conveying the message, received guidance on his conduct in specific social contexts to serve as a model for the community. This incident illustrates the dynamic nature of prophetic guidance, where divine instruction addresses both major rulings and subtle behavioral nuances.
